reason: Provides a Windows DSH preset that runs agent shell commands through Git Bash, with executable discovery, subprocess controls, and sandbox-policy gating.

summaries.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH 极简模式提供通过 Git Bash 执行 shell 命令的可安装代理预设。
summaries.en: Provides an installable DSH agent preset that executes shell commands through Git Bash for the minimal mode on Windows.

capabilities: Installs a DSH agent preset into the user preset directory
Executes shell commands through Git Bash
Manages command timeouts, output limits, and process termination
